summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on PR #558 by triaging, fixing, and replying to each unresolved thread.
summary.outcome: One unresolved CodeRabbit thread was found and fixed: the inode rebuild path for unresolved files was not clearing attr.size/attr.blocks to zero, causing stale sizes in GETATTR/READDIR responses. The fix was committed after tests (96 passed) and clippy passed.

repo: In crates/fuse/src/inode.rs, there are two inode rebuild paths: one for files (which was missing the attr.size/attr.blocks reset) and one for folders via populate_folder (which correctly sets display_size=0 on unresolved rebuild). Both paths should behave symmetrically.

The FUSE inode layer tracks resolved/unresolved state in the `kind` field with size:0, but attr fields (attr.size, attr.blocks) must be explicitly cleared separately — they are not derived from `kind`.

code.finding: Unresolved file inode rebuild must zero out attr.size and attr.blocks to match what populate_folder does for folders; omitting this causes GETATTR/READDIR to report stale sizes until re-resolution.

workflow: CodeRabbit review comments appear in unresolved GraphQL reviewThreads; the workflow correctly uses GraphQL to fetch and REST to reply, then GraphQL mutation to resolve.
Clippy and the full test suite (cargo test) are sufficient local gates before committing FUSE inode changes — no E2E run was needed for this attr-field fix.
